These are the VCs that made the most AI investments from 2025 until now:

Source: Multiples, data as of 28 Sep 2026

1. Andreessen Horowitz — 122 AI investments, 40% of all deals 2025-26 —  key AI holdings include OpenAI, Databricks, Cognition and Safe Superintelligence. Famously missed Anthropic
2. General Catalyst — 122 AI investments, 38% of all deals 2025-26 — backer of Anthropic, Mistral, Cognition and defence AI software Helsing.
3. Sequoia Capital — 116 AI investments, 47% of all deals 2025-26 — positions in Anthropic, OpenAI, chip designer Etched and Fireworks AI.
4. Khosla Ventures — 102 AI investments, 50% of all deals 2025-26 — holdings include Cognition, Lovable, Abridge and Fact

Hardware Deep Tech Can Scale Again

Many investors know AI software companies, but fewer know Etched.

Etched is a U.S. semiconductor and deep-tech company developing purpose-built infrastructure for AI inference. Its rise demonstrates an important shift: major investment is no longer limited to AI models, software, and cloud services.

Investors are also prepared to support ambitious hardware companies when they solve a clear computing bottleneck, possess meaningful technical differentiation, and turn complex engineering into a scalable platform.

Positive One Corporation is not trying to become another Etched or develop a competing data-center AI processor.
